run_code_formula_predictor: run the CodeFormulaPredictor on a directory of PNG images to detect code and formula regions
test_code_formula_predictor: test the CodeFormulaPredictor module with a specified device and image directory
create_code_formula_predictor: create a CodeFormulaPredictor instance from a HuggingFace model artifact path
predict_code_formula: predict code and formula regions in a list of PIL images using the CodeFormulaPredictor
download_code_formula_model: download the ds4sd/CodeFormula model from HuggingFace Hub for local inference
